svg.text: STAGE 519 · TOPIC 159 · P1031 🎉–P1032 🎉 · SVG 163 · 161st FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 1,040th GUARDRAIL, 1,050th PROBE & 860th LIVE POC MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 3311 / RFC 3261 UPDATE Offer/Answer Glare (491) & Early Target-Refresh Hijack Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 3311 UPDATE Path (Glare Clipping & Hijack)
1. Unrejected SDP Offer Glare (Missing 491 Request Pending)
UPDATE (Offer A) collides with 183/200 OK or UPDATE (Offer B)
• Overwriting pending SDP Offer desynchronizes codec & RTP ports
• Clips first 2–3 seconds of AI Voice Agent opening greeting!
2. Pre-Answer Early-Dialog Contact Target-Refresh Hijack
Early UPDATE + Contact: <sip:attacker@evil.example.com>
• RFC 3311 UPDATE refreshes dialog Remote Target before 200 OK
• Diverts subsequent ACK, re-INVITE, and BYE to attacker host
3. Unbounded 18x Pre-Answer UPDATE Renegotiation Flood
18 UPDATE requests during 3s ringing -> Transcoder churn DoS
• Repeatedly reallocates DSP/GPU audio codec pipelines pre-answer
• Exhausts SBC early-media transaction state tables
✅ Deterministic RFC 3311 Guardrails (P1031 🎉 + P1032 🎉)
P1031 🎉 (1,040th Guardrail!): 491 Glare Mutex & [100, 4000]ms
action: "reject_update_offer_glare_with_491_and_enforce_backoff_ms"
• Rejects colliding UPDATE SDP offers with 491 Request Pending
• clampedUnrejectedUpdateOfferGlareCollisions = 0 (zero clipping)
• clampedGlareRetryBackoffMs in [100, 4000]ms
Policy: P1031-SIP-RFC3311-UPDATE-OFFER-ANSWER-GLARE-AND-PENDING-OFFER-GUARD
P1032 🎉 (1,050th Probe & 860th POC!): Early Target Lock & [1, 4] Cap
action: "lock_early_dialog_remote_target_and_cap_update_count"
• Blocks unauthenticated early-dialog Contact URI redirects
• clampedHijackedEarlyDialogRemoteTargetRedirects = 0
• clampedMaxEarlyDialogUpdatesPerCall in [1, 4] updates
Policy: P1032-SIP-RFC3311-EARLY-DIALOG-UPDATE-TARGET-REFRESH-AND-RATE-GUARD
